$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 192. The engine can run in two places and no document says so. docs/installation.md documents hosts and paths; it does not document where the ENGINE runs, or which acts stay with a human when it runs somewhere the human is not. Standalone: engine on a laptop, agent in an editor, every non-blocking unknown read by someone. In-repository: engine inside a cloud agent's run, no human in the loop for its duration -- same engine, same dispositions, and an advisory unknown is advice to nobody. THE DEPENDENCY IS A CRITERION, NOT A NOTE (C4). This document cannot honestly describe the unattended mode as supported while issue 189 is open: escalate_to_blocking is inert in completion.py, so a barless item reads CONTINUE with STOP_COMPLETE unreachable whatever the repository's assessed profile, and the mode's central safety property does not hold. A document that describes it anyway would be the completion firewall's failure restated as prose. THE TRAP THIS BAR IS BUILT AGAINST is the one AGENTS.md:80 records this repository losing once: a new document that hand-writes a derivable fact becomes the second source of truth section 54 opens with. C3 asserts the page states no count at all -- it cites adapters and ADRs by path and lets the reader follow them.

criteria.$comment: C1 the document exists and names BOTH modes. A page describing only the local case is what already exists.

C2 THE HAZARD IS STATED. Assignment is the handoff -- assigning an issue to a cloud agent is already what the milestone signal reads as authorization -- and if anything ever lets an agent assign itself, admission collapses into self-authorization. AGENTS.md:48 forbids the milestone version of that move; nothing states the assignee equivalent.

C3 IT CITES, IT DOES NOT RECOUNT. No adapter, suite, role or ADR count anywhere on the page. A number here is a second source of truth that no suite is watching, which is exactly how 'the seven roles' survived (issue 187).
C4 THE DEPENDENCY. Issue 189's assertion must be green before this page may describe the unattended mode as supported. Red today by construction, and deliberately so.
C5 the page is reachable. A document nothing links to is a document nobody reads; installation.md is where someone asking 'how do I run this' already is.
